original_checks.limitation: This preserves a published strict bound and submersion duration. It does not create a point, identify an unstated water temperature/standard/specimen, or admit a measurement.

original_checks.raw_original_span: Test performed at 50mm/min on ISO 3167 A test specimens
original_checks.limitation: The span precedes the tensile table. It states test rate and specimen geometry only, without establishing printed/moulded specimen form, a moisture state, direction or post-treatment.

code_semantics.literal_numeric_bounds: Tag removal now requires a letter after the opening bracket; raw < 1 and escaped <50 survive. Original source text is not numerically normalized.
code_semantics.span_capture: Standalone span blocks are retained; inline spans represented in parent paragraphs or leaf wrappers are suppressed. The adjusted containment offset counts the opening tag length.
code_semantics.cache_version: html/tables v3 makes old version-2 derivatives unavailable through cachedText and causes documentText to reread actual bytes. PDF extractor version remains unchanged.
code_semantics.refresh_helper: Visits existing HTML cache entries in source inventory only; locate verifies original SHA-256 before documentText reread. No fetch or canonical table write. Current entries are retained; unavailable/out-of-inventory states are counted explicitly.
code_semantics.open_problem: The defect entry correctly distinguishes repaired extraction from still-unadmitted tensile context; no invented printed or moulded classification.

release_conditions: Full verification must pass under the new reader/cache derivatives.
Compiled diff must demonstrate that no canonical fact, numerical/decision lane or source digest/revision changed.
Pin actual refresh and source-context receipts in the final release attestation.
review_scope: Only the two named actual originals, narrow reader/test/cache-refresh implementation and corrected existing OPEN-PROBLEMS custody text were reviewed; no general source audit or deciding-fact admission.
